verdict.rationale: Bulk action is a fair question for an AI assistant app, but the evidence only implies it. Gemini can ingest many items at once (a whole code folder or GitHub repo, multiple documents) and, through Connected Apps, "take actions, like editing and managing your content in other apps." Nothing documents applying one operation across many items in a single step. Missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk editing or actions across multiple items, documented limits or scope of bulk actions, and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-item operations.
